returns.authority: The remaining bootstrap authority, or zero if disabled.

params.moduleAddress: The module implementation address to store.

params.moduleAddresses: The module implementation addresses to store.
params.moduleIds: The module identifiers to register or replace.

params.bootstrapAuthority_: Temporary setup authority used only for initial module registration.

returns.authorized: Whether the account is an authorized module.

bootstrapAuthority().notice: Returns the temporary bootstrap authority address.

bootstrapSetModule(bytes32,address).notice: Registers or replaces a module while bootstrap authority is still active.

bootstrapSetModules(bytes32[],address[]).notice: Registers or replaces multiple module pointers during bootstrap.

disableBootstrapAuthority().notice: Permanently removes the temporary bootstrap authority.

getModule(bytes32).notice: Returns the canonical module address for a module identifier.

getModuleRecord(bytes32).notice: Returns the full module record for a module identifier.

governanceRegisterModule(bytes32,address.notice: Registers a new module pointer through the governed execution path.

governanceUpdateModule(bytes32,address).notice: Replaces the canonical pointer for an existing module through the governed execution path.

isAuthorizedModule(address).notice: Returns true when an account is one of the active registered modules.
